description: Canonical deterministic 21-day multi-echelon supply chain dataset for SupplyShield AI demonstration and resilience evaluation.
limitations: Synthetic deterministic daily demand profile without external stochastic variation
Primary supplier SUP-01 is subject to deterministic shutdown outage for 1-14 days
Alternate supplier SUP-02 enforces strict 60 units/day shared daily capacity constraint
Factory assembly throughput (FAC-01: 100, FAC-02: 80) is topological structural metadata (NOT_MODELED as binding simulation constraint)
Distribution center storage buffers (DC-01, DC-02) are topological structural metadata (NOT_MODELED as binding simulation constraint)
Unmet customer demand is accounted under period-specific lost-service convention (no backlog queue carryover)
External enterprise ERP integrations and real-world purchase order dispatch are NOT_CONFIGURED
